messages:
Zoey Park: Idea: small launch post w/ embedded 1-click interactive demo (one free inline run), then gate extended runs behind a tiny credit offer. want to test credit friction vs RSVP lift.
Caleb Morris: sounds good. quick question: place credit claim on the post, or in confirmation email after RSVP?
Anika Rao: split both. Arm A: claim on post (30 tokens). Arm B: claim only in confirm email after RSVP. Control: demo + RSVP no credit.
Rafael Ortiz: routing: enterprise domains -> create SF lead + tag 'inline-demo-2026'; others -> growth inbox. if redeemed_tokens >= 150 -> create SDR task.
Caleb Morris: analytics plan: track demo_inline_run (anon cookie), demo_claimed, promptpack_installed, first_5_requests, webinar_rsvp, paid_conversion_14d. add campaign property "inline-launch-30t".
Anika Rao: creative: hero graphic + in-post demo embed spec, 3 email variants, 2 short GIFs. timeline: draft Mon, design Tue EOD, embed dev Wed. soft launch Fri to seeded 10k.
Zoey Park: also randomize credit sizes small (15) vs medium (30) to measure marginal lift. metric: % reach first_5 within 72h and RSVP rate.
Caleb Morris: events snippet to wire:

```
demo_inline_view
demo_inline_run_anonymous
demo_claimed_inline
promptpack_installed
first_5_requests
webinar_rsvp
```

Caleb Morris: we'll use property credit_tier and anon_cookie_id to stitch anonymous runs to later claims.
Rafael Ortiz: webhook -> #growth-inbound with payload (campaign, email_domain, redeemed_tokens, credit_tier). ops: can we reserve a small fastpath for demo traffic first 48h? median latency <200ms would help conversions.
ops-bot: feature-flag 'inline_demo_fastpath' created (default off). ops will triage with eng-ml.
Anika Rao: post-launch benchmark doc template: hypothesis, arms & cohort sizes, primary metrics (demo_run%, claim%, first_5%, RSVP%), token economics (redeemed_tokens * token_cost + infra uplift), latency notes, surprises, recommended next step. include screenshots + dashboard links.
Zoey Park: routing nuance: if user redeems and domain looks enterprise but not in allowlist -> create SF lead and mark as 'needs-qualification'.
Caleb Morris: timeline recap: tracking wired by Tue, creative Wed morning, embed ready Thu, soft-launch Fri 9am PT, run 8 days, postmortem 1 week after.
Rafael Ortiz: I'll add dedupe rules for claims vs RSVP and open SF mapping ticket.
Anika Rao: quick subject lines to test: 'Try Redwood in one prompt (free demo)' vs 'Join our short demo + credits' 
s cold vs warm.
Zoey Park: perfect. I'll post checklist to #marketing-prod tomorrow and tag follow-ups. thanks team! :sparkles:
